description: Submit a SHA-256 digest and receive a Time-Stamp Authority's signed RFC 3161 token over it: evidence that the data you hashed existed at that time, verifiable against the authority without trusting or contacting this service. Hash your data yourself - it never leaves your side. Your first 3 each day are free, no payment needed. Then 0.05 USDC for one, or 0.50 for up to 10 in a single call and a single payment, bound to one timestamp by a Merkle root. Paid over x402. No account, nothing stored here afterwards.

digests.description: Up to 10 digests in one call and one payment, bound to a single timestamp by a Merkle root. Each comes back with the proof that binds it.

name: timestamp_receipt
title: RFC 3161 timestamp receipt
